question: Find the area of a parallelogram, whose base is (3x − 5y + 4) m and height is (x - 5y) m.
solution:
**Given:**

Base = (3x - 5y + 4) m

Height = (x - 5y) m

**Formula used:**

Area of parallelogram = Base × Height

**Calculation:**

⇒ Area = (3x - 5y + 4) × (x - 5y)

⇒ = 3x(x - 5y) - 5y(x - 5y) + 4(x - 5y)

⇒ = 3x² - 15xy - 5xy + 25y² + 4x - 20y

⇒ = 3x² - 20xy + 25y² + 4x - 20y

∴ Area =** (3x² + 25y² - 20xy + 4x - 20y) { m}².**
